name: Curvature-Based Feature Contouring
aliases: Curvature-Based Feature Contouring — Transfer Functions Based on Surface Curvature
Transfer Functions Based on Surface Curvature
definition: A technique using transfer functions based on surface curvature to render feature contours with roughly constant image-space thickness, clarifying the shape and position of individual bones.
summary: Curvature-Based Feature Contouring is a non-photorealistic volume rendering technique that renders feature contours with constant image-space thickness by applying curvature correction to silhouette rendering.
